exposure: postpartum insertion of intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD)
cohort: 7410 women who delivered at a teaching hospital in Kalyani, West Bengal, India between January 1, 2016 and December 31, 2016
finding: The acceptance rate of PPIUCD insertion was 52.5%, and of those who followed up at 6 weeks, 90.77% were willing to continue using PPIUCD.
